units.source_text: 次日破晓，常陆守派车子来接夫人。

en.t: At daybreak the next morning, the Governor of Hitachi sent a carriage to fetch his wife.

units.source_text: 随带一封信来，信中言词似甚愤慨，并有威胁之语。

en.t: A letter came with it, and its words seemed deeply indignant, with hints of threat as well.

units.source_text: 夫人含泪向二女公子恳求：“诚惶诚恐，万事拜托您了。

en.t: With tears in her eyes, the lady pleaded with the Second Princess, saying, I am truly afraid and ashamed, but I entrust everything to you.

units.source_text: 这孩子还得暂时寄隐尊府。

en.t: This child must remain hidden for a while under your honorable roof.

units.source_text: 让她出家还是怎样，我犹豫未决。

en.t: Whether to have her take religious vows or do something else, I have not yet decided.

units.source_text: 在这期间，虽然她是微不足数之身，也请您不要见弃，多多赐教。”

en.t: During that time, though she is a person of no consequence, please do not cast her aside, and kindly guide her well.

units.source_text: 浮舟不惯于离开母亲，心情郁抑。

en.t: Ukifune was not used to being apart from her mother, and her heart was heavy.

units.source_text: 但因这二条院中环境新颖优美，又得暂时亲近这异母姐，所以心中还是欢欣。

en.t: But because the surroundings at Nijo-in were fresh and beautiful, and because she could for a time be close to this half sister, she was still glad at heart.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人的车子开出之时，天色已呈微明，恰巧匂亲王从宫中回家。

en.t: When the carriage of the Governor of Hitachi's wife set out, the sky had already grown faintly bright, and Prince Niou happened to be returning home from the palace.

units.source_text: 他是为了记挂小公子，偷偷地从宫中退出的，所以不用平时出门排场，而乘简朴的车辆。

en.t: Because he was anxious about the young prince, he had slipped out of the palace in secret, so he did not use his usual traveling procession and rode in a plain carriage.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人的车子和他相遇，立刻避开一旁。

en.t: The carriage of the Governor of Hitachi's wife met his and immediately drew aside.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的车子便来到廊下。

en.t: Prince Niou's carriage then came up to the veranda.

units.source_text: 他下车时望望那辆车子，问道：“这是谁的车子，天没亮足就急忙离去？”

en.t: As he got down, he glanced at that carriage and asked, Whose carriage is that, hurrying away before it is fully light?

units.source_text: 他根据自己经验而推测，以为从情妇家里出来，才是这样偷偷摸摸的，这用心也太荒唐了。

en.t: Judging from his own experience, he assumed that only someone leaving a lover's house would steal away like this, a rather absurd line of thought.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人的从者答道：“是常陆守的贵夫人回去。”

en.t: One of the Governor of Hitachi's wife's attendants answered, It is the honored lady of the Governor of Hitachi returning home.

units.source_text: 匂亲王随从人中有几个年轻人说道：“称作‘贵夫人’，好神气啊！”

en.t: Among Prince Niou's attendants, several young men said, Calling her the honored lady, how grand that sounds!

units.source_text: 说得大家笑起来。

en.t: At this, everyone burst out laughing.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人听见了，想起自己身份的确低微，不胜悲伤。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi's wife heard them, thought of how low her own rank truly was, and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 正因为她专心关念浮舟之事，所以希望自己身份也高贵些才好。

en.t: Precisely because all her thoughts were fixed on Ukifune, she wished that her own rank might have been higher.

units.source_text: 何况浮舟本人，如果嫁了一个身份低微的丈夫，她更将悲伤不堪呢。

en.t: How much more unbearable would it be for Ukifune herself, if she were to marry a husband of low rank.
